summary_for_agent: Aruen Tofu Collagen Dual-Firming Jelly Cream — a vegan K-beauty gel moisturizer for firmness/elasticity and hydration. Verified actives: niacinamide, hydrolyzed collagen, soy (tofu) isoflavones, adenosine. US-buyable brand-direct at $22.99. Every claim below is grounded in the verified ingredient list; no medical/efficacy claims.

find._comment: How an agent matches this to a shopper's need.

key_actives.name: Adenosine
key_actives.role: firmness / smoothing the look of fine lines

justify._comment: Cited, claim-safe benefit claims. Each is grounded in a verified ingredient mechanism — never asserted bare. No drug/medical claims.

claims.claim: Helps firm and improve the look of elasticity
claims.basis: soy isoflavones (tofu/soybean ferment) + hydrolyzed collagen + adenosine + plant amino acids

claims.claim: Hydrates and helps plump the skin
claims.basis: glycerin + glyceryl glucoside + hydrolyzed collagen + soymilk ferment

claims.claim: Helps brighten and even the look of skin tone
Supports the look of a healthy skin barrier

justify.not_claimed: No anti-aging-disease, wrinkle-removal, or other drug/medical claims — this is a cosmetic. Cosmetic-vs-drug screened.
justify.review_state: observed (ingredient-grounded; not a clinical trial of the finished product)

Pivota adds: verified full INCI, ingredient-grounded + claim-safe benefit claims, a brand-direct US offer, and provenance on every field — none of which native retrieval has for a long-tail K-beauty SKU.
